label: joint instrumentation sensitivity matrix of the resistance-proxy (vreg_R_pack_mohm) months coefficient, powerFade S1 design; estimated proxy, a conditional association in one warm window, not a degradation rate, SOH or true resistance

factors.A: A0 production alignment | A1 synchronous-interpolation variant (M505 Rev 2 R1)
factors.G: G0 none | G1 gridChange indicator | G2 gridChange drives excluded
factors.C: C0 none | C1 eff_dt_s + coverage_frac (S1) | C2 C1 + fast-regime indicator (powerFade S3)
factors.T: T0 linear | T1 quadratic | T2 hinge (knots frozen on F* terciles)

gridDefinition.rule: gridChange = (current class, round(voltage step, 6)) differs from the frozen modal pair; undefined classes leave F*

reference.note: A0,G0,C1,T0 evaluated on F*; the published S1 estimate remains the only primary

ladder.l2Needs: blind audit and Director decision before display

statement: Joint instrumentation sensitivity matrix of the resistance-proxy months coefficient (powerFade S1 design; 54 pre-declared cells: alignment A0/A1 x logged grid period G0/G1/G2 x cadence and support C0/C1/C2 x temperature specification T0/T1/T2) on one paired drive set. It reports how the reading changes across choices; it replaces no estimate, is a conditional association in one warm window (not a degradation rate, SOH or true resistance), and G1/G2 are aliased with calendar time (one contiguous logged-grid run). Cells are never selected or averaged.
repeatedLooks: re-run at every ingestion, no alpha spending; up to 216 intervals, no multiplicity adjustment; a ladder change escalates to the Director

notCovered: the A1 proxy computation itself (audited at M505; the sidecar equals the M505 per-drive values)
fidelity against the author's code beyond the numbers (blind part only)
blindAuditRef.verdict: reproduced: all 54 cells (slopes, day / ISO-week / M7 / M14 intervals, failed-draw counts, decisive flags) and the ladder level L1

mcRule: an M7/M14 interval is non-decisive when its endpoint nearest zero lies within 2 x the larger Monte Carlo SD of the two endpoints (8 repeats on separate streams; the 2 x SD threshold is an implementation choice taken from the M494 result review, recorded here)
